content: 1. The packaging system referred to as 1 can be utilized for the transportation of exempt human specimens or exempt animal specimens via all modes of transport. However, for infectious substances classified under Category A, Category B, or Medical/Clinical Wastes (UN 3291), a triple packaging system with more specific and detailed requirements is mandatory. 2. The packaging system 1 is also applicable for the transportation of exempt human or animal specimens by all modes of transport. For infectious substances classified as Category A (affecting humans or animals under UN 3549), Category B, or Medical Waste, a triple packaging system with stringent requirements must be used. 3. The UN Model Regulations, along with other modal agreements, provide detailed information sheets that outline the specific packaging requirements for various classifications and sub-classifications of dangerous goods. These information sheets are commonly referred to as packing instructions, and four of these may be relevant to the shipment of infectious substances. 4. The UN Model Regulations, as well as other modal agreements, produce detailed information sheets outlining the packaging requirements for different classifications and sub-classifications of dangerous goods. These sheets, known as packing instructions, include four that may apply to the shipment of infectious substances (refer to Annex 4). 5. According to the UN Model Regulations, a minimum set of information must be documented for any infectious substance in the form of a Dangerous Goods Transport Document (DGTD). A DGTD is required for all shipments of Category A infectious substances (UN 2814 and UN 2900) and for Medical or Clinical Wastes (UN 3291). 6. As per the UN Model Regulations, a minimum set of information must be recorded for any infectious substance in the form of a Dangerous Goods Transport Document (DGTD). A DGTD is mandatory for all shipments of Category A infectious substances (UN 2814 and UN 2900) and for Medical or Clinical Wastes (UN 3291 and UN 3549). 7. For Category A infectious substances, the Handling Information box must include the statement: Dangerous Goods as per associated Shipper's Declaration. If applicable (e.g., the volume of the substance is greater than 50 mL), the statement Cargo Aircraft Only or CAO must also be included. 8. For Category A infectious substances, the Handling Information box must include the statement: Dangerous Goods as per associated Shipper's Declaration. If applicable (e.g., the volume of the substance is between 50 mL and 4 L, or the weight is between 50 g and 4 kg), the statement Cargo Aircraft Only or CAO must also be included. These corrections have been incorporated into the electronic file.
